277304850.description:
Cross
Yellow Gold Filled Pen and Pencil Set
Vintage American Writing Instruments
This vintage Cross writing set features a matching ballpoint pen and mechanical pencil finished in elegant yellow gold fill. A staple of professional gift-giving and executive stationery for decades, Cross instruments are renowned for their slim profiles, signature conical tops, and reliable twist-action mechanisms. This set represents mid-to-late 20th-century office luxury and comes complete with its original presentation case and accessories.
Classic slim-profile design with yellow gold-filled finish and ribbed linear pattern
Set includes both a twist-action ballpoint pen and a matching mechanical pencil
Original presentation box with brown textured exterior and cream satin lining
Includes genuine leather pen purse with gold-tone rose emblem and instructions
Condition:
Good vintage condition overall. The gold-filled finish shows light surface scratching and minor age-appropriate wear to the polished surfaces. The presentation box remains structurally sound, though there is light fraying to the internal brown fabric securing bands. Both the pen and pencil currently require new ink refills or lead cartridges to be operational.
